outline:
本課程旨在教導學生如何報告及增加演講之技巧。課程中會包含一些文法及常用的句子介紹。於課堂中亦會撥放相關影片增進聽力之能力，於課堂中亦會有小組討論且每一位學生都有機會上台報告討論。發音咬字的糾正也會於報告中修正。
This course aims to help the students know how to present their research and provide some skills to thoroughly give their speech. This course contains grammar and sentence structure. Additionally, listening practice such as watching some videos will also be included to improve listening skills. The course will have some small group activities to discuss, and everyone will have a chance to speak. Some corrections of the pronunciation will also be included in the class.
